scenes.title: The Ashen Gate
scenes.text: A warm wind carries sparks from the sealed Emberfall road.

scenes.title: The Glass Orchard
scenes.text: Crystalline fruit chimes softly among copper-leaved trees.

scenes.title: Cinder Ferry
scenes.text: A lantern boat waits on a river of silver mist.

options.text: Trade a kind story for passage

scenes.title: The Bell That Forgot
scenes.text: A tower bell hangs silent above a village of soot-blue roofs.

scenes.title: The Moss Library
scenes.text: Green shelves breathe the scent of rain and old paper.

scenes.title: Lantern Fen
scenes.text: Floating lights mark a safe path through a quiet marsh.

scenes.title: The Clockwork Mill
scenes.text: A wooden mill turns though the stream has run dry.

scenes.title: The Warm Cavern
scenes.text: The cave glows like a hearth and echoes with gentle humming.

scenes.title: Copper Bridge
scenes.text: A narrow bridge spans a canyon filled with amber clouds.

scenes.title: Comet Meadow
scenes.text: A tiny fallen star rests in the clover, warm and unharmed.

scenes.title: Marble Steppe
scenes.text: White stones form a path across the sunlit plain.

scenes.title: Whispering Well
scenes.text: The well repeats the last kind thing spoken nearby.

scenes.title: Frosted Archive
scenes.text: Snowflakes drift indoors around a map carved in ice.

scenes.title: Ember Market
scenes.text: A cheerful night market trades recipes and bright buttons.

scenes.title: The Root Cellar
scenes.text: A giant root has lifted the cellar door without breaking it.

scenes.title: The Sunken Stage
scenes.text: A tiny theater rests in a clear pool, its curtain still bright.

scenes.title: Paper Kite Cliff
scenes.text: A message kite is caught on a ledge above the trail.

scenes.title: The Quiet Volcano
scenes.text: A volcano puffs harmless rings of warm steam.

scenes.title: Starling Roost
scenes.text: A flock of starlings circles a tower with a missing weather vane.

scenes.title: Dawn Viaduct
scenes.text: The last bridge into Emberfall glows at the edges of morning.

riddles.question: I have hands but no fingers, and I tell the day without a voice. What am I?
The more I dry, the wetter I become. What am I?
I have a face and two hands, yet no arms or legs. What am I?
I can travel around the world while staying in one corner. What am I?
I grow shorter as I give light. What am I?
I have many keys but open no locks; music lives in me. What am I?
I follow you by day but disappear in the dark. What am I?
I have a neck but no head and hold a little drink. What am I?
I fall from the sky but never get hurt. What am I?
I have a bed but never sleep, and a mouth but never eat. What am I?
I am full of holes yet can carry water. What am I?
I show towns and rivers but contain no houses or fish. What am I?
I get bigger when you take more away from me. What am I?
I have one eye but cannot see, and help mend a tear. What am I?
I am heard but never seen, and answer when a canyon calls. What am I?
